verificationNote: v1.3.0 (2026-04-23): CMO 25 OCR'd end-to-end via tesseract 5 (raw text retained at evaluation-frameworks/ocr/cmo-25-s2015.ocr.txt). Section 6 Program Outcomes cross-checked against OCR, revealing structural errors in earlier template-based paraphrases: BSCS has 10 outcomes (CS01–CS10), not 14; common outcomes are 5 (§6.1 a–e), not 6. The BSCS paraphrase was rewritten with OCR-verified wording; `bscs-po-1`..`bscs-po-10` now map 1:1 to CS01..CS10 (earlier aliases bscs-po-11..14 removed — they were template hallucinations not present in the CMO itself). BSIS expanded from 7 to the CMO's actual 10 outcomes for completeness (unused by the pipeline but kept for cross-walk). common-po-6 removed (no canonical basis). BSIT outcome count (13) unchanged; IT01–IT13 aliases retained. CMO 87: bscpe-po-a and bscpe-po-e corrected to include 'complex' per OCR-verified wording. Assessment-slate.md Program-emphasis lines re-threaded against the corrected BSCS clause numbering. v1.2.1 changes (SFIA 9 code/name verification, CC2020 KA-* relabel to CS2013, CMO 87 letter labels, Wayback stable-mirror URLs) remain in effect.
